[yocto] [PATCH 2/3] add updated version of linux-3.0.0-cdv.patch

rahul . saxena Thu, 26 Apr 2012 09:08:36 -0700 

From: Rahul Saxena <[email protected]>

Add updated version of linux-3.0.0-cdv patch for pvr driver
This version includes vaapi (Video Acceleration API) related fixes

Note that the patch is too large to post completely, pl see repo for actual 
changes.

Signed-off-by: Rahul Saxena <[email protected]>
